summary: MapBiomas Argentina (Collection 2) is produced by the MapBiomas Argentina initiative for annual land cover and land use monitoring. It separates 3 Closed forests from 4 Open forests and splits shrublands into 66 Closed shrublands, 77 Open shrublands and 63 Shrubs and herbaceous mosaic, a canopy-based vocabulary consistent with how Argentina's native forest law defines forest by cover rather than by biome. Evidence is as far as the legend code sheet supports it; the ATBD should be checked before accepting these nodes.

instruments.title: MapBiomas Argentina annual mapping programme (Collection 2)
instruments.effect_on_classes: Defines the level-1 aggregates (1 Forests, 10, 14, 22, 26, 27) and the closed/open splits for forests (3/4) and shrublands (66/77) plus a shrub-herbaceous mosaic (63).

instruments.title: Argentine Native Forest Law (Ley 26.331, 2007)
instruments.effect_on_classes: The law's minimum-budget regime for native forests is applied through canopy-cover-based forest definitions and provincial land-use zoning, which is consistent with the closed/open forest split (3/4) and the treatment of open shrublands as non-forest; the thresholds themselves are not stated in the legend sheet. Likely instrument; not cited in the source.
